article_content: Everton has received a 10-point deduction from the Premier League due to a breach of financial rules. The club violated profitability and sustainability rules over three years, ending in the 2021-22 season. Manchester City faces similar accusations, with over 100 breaches alleged. Everton accepts the breach but disputes the severity of the sanction, planning to appeal. The Premier League will monitor similar cases closely.

Everton prihvata kršenje, ali osporava težinu kazne, planirajući žalbu.

article_content: A mother and her teenage daughter from Connecticut, who were facing the prospect of homelessness due to job loss, have been saved after the girl blogged about the family business on Tumblr. Danielle Walters, 14, found out her mom had been laid off from her job at a bank, so she took it upon herself to try and boost the small craft business run by her mother in her spare time. In a desperate heartfelt plea to generate some interest and allay fears that the two could lose their home, she posted about the company, Suffield Sundries, which sells artisan candles and soaps. The post included a snapshot of the business card and requested that others reblog the picture to help her mom's business get out there.
translated_content: Majka i kći iz Konektikata, koje su bile suočelile da će izgubiti stanovanje, su spasene nakon što je kći blogirala o porodichnom biznisu na Tumblru. Danijel Volters, 14 godina, saznala je da jojka izgubila posao sa posla na banci, pa je uzela da pomogne malom obrtu koji vodi ručnoj izradeću i sapune.
post_content: Teen helps mom's business go viral on Tumblr! #smallbusiness #supportlocal #family

article_content: A novel method for generating electricity from waste carbon dioxide emitted by power stations has been developed by Dutch researchers. This technique has the potential to produce a substantial amount of power, equivalent to 400 times the annual output of the Hoover Dam. The process involves combining water and other liquids with combustion gas containing a high concentration of carbon dioxide, which is then pumped between two membranes to produce an electric current. This system leverages waste gases from power stations and industrial facilities as raw materials to generate electricity, providing a potential solution to mitigate greenhouse gas emissions. According to the researchers, over 12 billion tonnes of carbon dioxide are emitted annually from coal, oil, and natural gas power stations, while home and commercial heating systems generate an additional 11 billion tonnes of this greenhouse gas. The team believes that their method could produce approximately 1,570 billion kilowatts of electricity annually, which is equivalent to 400 times the Hoover Dam's annual output.

Ova tehnika ima potencijal da proizvede 400 puta više energije nego što godišnje proizvodi Heverov brana. Procesom se kombinuju voda i drugi tečnosti sa sagorevačom gasom koji sadrži visoku koncentraciju ugljenika, koji se zatim pumpa između dve membrane da bi se proizveo strujni tok. Ovaj sistem koristi otpadne gaze iz termoelektrana i industrijskih dimnjaka kao sirovine materijale za proizvodnju električne energije, nudeći potencijalno rešenje za smanjenje emisija ugljenika.

article_content: Google's Street View service now includes a time-travel feature, allowing users to explore historical images from 2007 to 2013. The feature enables users to view changes in areas over time, including the construction of notable landmarks like New York's Freedom Tower. A clock icon and scrollbar have been added, allowing users to change the year and season of the area they are viewing, providing a unique perspective on how places have transformed.
